title: Custom Intune role duplicates a built-in role

report.title: {Items.Count} custom {Plural(Items.Count, 'role duplicates', 'roles duplicate')} a built-in role

messages.businessImpact: Custom roles have to be maintained as Intune adds permissions, while built-in roles are maintained by Microsoft. Duplicating one creates work with no benefit.
remediation: Replace the custom role with the built-in equivalent and delete it.
messages.cannotSee: A tenant whose built-in roles were not read. With nothing to compare against, nothing is claimed rather than every custom role being called original.
